answer: The copper test I would run is Warranted housekeeper registration with housekeepers institute attestation: a registration the institute renews after room audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a registration the institute renews after room audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the ocean is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The dune grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
